newsitem.title: NORWAY: Nera plans move into U.S. telecoms market.
newsitem.headline: Nera plans move into U.S. telecoms market.

text.p: Norway's largest manufacturer of telecommunications equipment Nera ASA said on Monday it planned to adapt high capacity radio link products to U.S. standards as a first step toward entering the North American market.
Nera said it would adapt its SDH microwave products for high capacity transmission of telecom signals to the U.S. standard known as SONET. The first SONET products should be ready by the end of 1997.

The first product to be delivered with SONET standard will be a high capacity access radio with add-drop functionality for STM-1 ring applications. The new "City Link" will be developed in frequencies from 18 to 28 giga hertz.

Nera said the move to the U.S. market followed the deregulation of the sector by the U.S. Congress, which "will create increased demand for transmission products from new suppliers during the coming years".
